mobile.locale.permissionNotice: Permission prompts follow the iOS language setting. Changing the app language may not change these prompts immediately.
mobile.ios.cameraUsage: Use the camera to attach photos to conversations or scan a QR code to connect this device to a workspace.
mobile.ios.faceIdUsage: Use Face ID to confirm instructions sent to agents from this device.
mobile.ios.localNetworkUsage: Use the local network to connect to an oort server on the same network.
mobile.ios.microphoneUsage: oort does not record audio. All features work without microphone access.
mobile.ios.photoLibraryUsage: Read your photo library to show recent photos for conversation attachments. Only photos you select are uploaded.
mobile.ios.photoLibraryAddUsage: oort does not save photos to your library. All features work without this permission.
